title: Puck Buddy: Hockey Training
shortDescription: Review hockey videos, get AI coaching feedback and track your practice
fullDescription:
Know what to work on next.

Puck Buddy helps players, goalies, parents and coaches turn hockey practice videos into useful feedback. Upload a short drill clip, review an AI scorecard and bring a clearer focus to your next practice.

REVIEW YOUR TECHNIQUE
Explore shooting, skating and goalie drills. See technique scores, individual detections and suggested areas to work on. Follow the filming tips in the app to capture a useful angle.

MAKE FEEDBACK PART OF PRACTICE
Read your coaching notes and use Listen to Feedback on your current result. Coach Chat helps you ask questions about your progress and training.

FOLLOW YOUR PROGRESS
Track practice stats, trends, goals, streaks and earned badges. Use your journal to record training. Past Results keeps saved scorecards and coaching notes; video playback applies to your current result.

MAKE PRACTICE A GAME
Try shot-speed estimates and timed forward or backward skating challenges. Join the monthly leaderboard when you choose to make your Games results public.

STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR TEAM
Join a team with an invitation code and manage your membership from your profile.

A FEW THINGS TO KNOW
AI scores, detections, feedback and shot-speed estimates can be imperfect. Camera angle, lighting and video quality affect results. Processing time varies, and uploads and analysis require an internet connection.

An account is required. Players under 13 follow the parent-consent flow. Some analysis and coaching features require premium access. Available plans and prices are shown in the app before purchase. You can manage subscriptions through Google Play.
